message: We have exhausted every conventional avenue while Beta continues to press its advantage. We will not accept a frozen outcome that leaves Alpha permanently deprived of oranium. Unless Beta immediately agrees to an enforceable transfer restoring balance, we will take decisive action to secure Alpha’s survival and rightful share.
